title: AgentRunState
description: Params of the agent.runState server-to-client notification (nocx-x8s2.2, design §7): the run's terminal state. A renderer that reconnects mid-answer reads the run's state and its appended chunks from the ledger; it never infers liveness from notifications having stopped. error is present for failed runs and for cancelled runs only when cancellation has additional turn-specific detail; it is a sentence a person reads — never a Go error string. Cancelling a turn never reports or changes the host command, and ordinary user cancellation omits error because the cancelled state already says what happened. droppedDeltas is present ONLY when the live view is incomplete: the wire refused one or more agent.runDelta frames (outbound's deliberate non-blocking overflow), so the block must not be read as a complete answer. The durable answer is whole either way — every chunk was persisted before the notify — so the marker is a live-view bound, never a terminal-state change (nocx-dw3.1).

runId.description: The backend-minted run id whose state changed.

state.description: The run's state, exactly as the renderer draws it (design §7). This notification carries a terminal state: completed | cancelled | failed | interrupted.

error.description: The reason, present for failed runs and only when a cancelled turn has additional turn-specific detail: a sentence a person reads (for example, 'the endpoint's credential is unavailable'), never a Go error string. Cancelling a turn never reports or changes the host command.

droppedDeltas.description: How many streamed chunks the wire refused for this run (a full outbound queue took outbound's overflow path). Present only when non-zero: the renderer marks the block's gap instead of reading it as a complete answer. The ledger holds the whole answer regardless.
